title: American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI) 2015 sample data

format.numbers: shortest exact decimal form of the source text (integers without a decimal point)

scaleEndpoints.source: scaleInformation.minValue / maxValue of the data settings file
scaleEndpoints.interpretation: The stored scale endpoints equal the observed minimum and maximum for every column: they are observed extrema, not verified theoretical endpoints.
